_note: Week of May 25 – May 31, 2026. Monday = Taco Night (shrimp + steak). Jake low-carb lunch bowl (ground turkey + quinoa + pasta sauce). Laine mason-jar chicken pasta salad (dressing separate).

dinners.name: Shrimp & Steak Tacos
dinners.note: Use the 16oz steak + frozen shrimp you already have. Toppings: sour cream, shredded cheese. Jake gets more steak, Laine more shrimp. Corn tortillas needed (or flour if that's what's on hand). Jake gets 3 tortillas, Laine 2.

ingredients.item: Cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt

steps: Season steak with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt. Let rest 10 min at room temp.
Sear steak in cast iron or heavy pan on high heat 3-4 min per side for medium. Rest 5 min before slicing thin against the grain.
In the same pan, add shrimp tossed with chili powder + cumin. Cook 2 min per side until pink. Finish with squeeze of lemon.
Warm tortillas directly on burner flame or dry pan 30 sec each side.
Build tacos: Jake gets 3 with more steak, Laine gets 2 with more shrimp. Top with sour cream + cheese.

dinners.name: Ground Turkey + Black Bean Skillet over Rice
dinners.note: Uses ground turkey, black beans, Signature Select pasta sauce (garlic basil works great here as an arrabiata-style). Serve over rice. Jake bigger portion, Laine less rice.
steps: Cook rice per package in salted water. Set aside.
Brown ground turkey in skillet over medium-high, breaking it up. Season with cumin, chili powder, garlic powder, salt.
Add garlic, stir 1 min. Add pasta sauce + black beans + frozen veggies. Simmer 8-10 min.
Serve over rice. Jake gets more turkey, less rice. Laine gets less turkey, more rice. Top both with shredded cheese.

dinners.name: Garlic Herb Pork Tenderloin + Hatch Chile Chowder
dinners.note: Use the Bettergoods Hatch Chile & Corn Chowder jar as a warm sauce/side. Tenderloin is stupid easy — season, sear, oven-finish. Jake gets more pork, Laine more chowder.

ingredients.item: Garlic powder, rosemary, smoked paprika, salt

steps: Pat tenderloin dry. Rub all over with garlic powder, smoked paprika, rosemary, salt, pepper.
Sear in oven-safe skillet with olive oil over high heat, 2 min per side until browned all around.
Transfer skillet to 425°F oven. Roast 15-18 min until internal temp hits 145°F. Rest 5 min before slicing.
Heat chowder in a pot over medium. Steam/microwave frozen veggies.
Plate: pork slices over or beside a ladle of chowder. Jake gets more pork, Laine more chowder. Top with shredded cheese.

dinners.name: Garlic Basil Pasta + Ground Turkey + Garbanzo Beans
dinners.note: Use the Signature Select Garlic Basil sauce. Jake gets spaghetti, Laine gets less pasta + more beans. Bread crumbs as topping.

ingredients.item: Signature Select garlic basil pasta sauce

steps: Cook spaghetti in salted water per package. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water before draining.
Brown turkey in skillet, season with garlic powder, salt, Italian seasoning.
Add pasta sauce + drained garbanzo beans. Simmer 5 min.
Toss drained pasta into the pan. Add pasta water to loosen if needed.
Stir in spinach off heat until wilted.
Plate: Jake gets more pasta, Laine more beans. Both get bread crumbs on top.

dinners.name: Dennison's Chili + Pinto Beans + Lentils
dinners.note: One can Dennison's as base, boost with pinto beans and lentils. High fiber, high protein, zero effort. Top with shredded cheese and sour cream. Jake bigger bowl.
steps: Simmer lentils in salted water 20 min. Drain.
Combine Dennison's chili + pinto beans + cooked lentils in a pot. Heat over medium 10 min.
Season with cumin, chili powder, garlic if needed.
Ladle: Jake gets the bigger bowl. Top both with cheese + sour cream.

dinners.name: Sliced Pork Tenderloin + Three Cheese Tomato Bisque + Pasta
dinners.note: Use remaining tenderloin. Bettergoods Three Cheese Tomato Bisque works beautifully as a sauce over pasta. Elegant low-effort Saturday. Jake more pasta + pork, Laine lighter.
steps: Cook spaghetti in salted water per package. Drain, reserve 1/4 cup pasta water.
Warm tenderloin slices in a pan over medium — just 2-3 min, it's already cooked.
Heat bisque in a pot. Toss cooked pasta in bisque, use pasta water to loosen if needed.
Stir spinach into the pasta off heat until wilted.
Plate: pasta + bisque base, pork slices on top. Jake bigger portion. Bread crumbs + cheese to finish.

dinners.name: Birch Benders Pancake Night + Egg White Scramble
dinners.note: Fun Sunday breakfast-for-dinner. Pancakes from the bag (just add water), egg white scramble on the side. Jake doubles the egg whites. Frozen fruit as topping.

ingredients.item: Liquid egg whites (mixed into batter + scramble)

steps: Mix pancake mix + half the egg whites + water per package directions. Add flaxseed to batter.
Cook pancakes on non-stick over medium, 2 min per side.
Scramble remaining egg whites in a separate pan with salt and shredded cheese.
Serve: pancakes topped with thawed frozen fruit. Scramble on the side.
Jake gets more pancakes + more egg white scramble.

jakeLunch.name: Ground Turkey + Quinoa Bowl with Tomato Sauce
jakeLunch.note: Low-carb batch. Quinoa kept small — it's there for texture and some carbs but turkey is the base. Pasta sauce (four cheese or garlic basil) as the sauce. Shredded cheese on top. Make 5 containers Sunday.

ingredients.item: Ground turkey 85/15 — full batch 2.5 lbs raw
Signature Select pasta sauce (four cheese or garlic basil) — 2.5 cups total

steps: Cook ALL quinoa: rinse 150g dry quinoa, simmer in 300ml salted water 15 min. Fluff and cool.
Brown ALL turkey (2.5 lbs) in a large pan over medium-high, breaking up. Season well with garlic powder, cumin, salt, pepper.
Steam or microwave all frozen veggies. Set aside.
Divide into 5 containers: quinoa base (30g worth cooked), then turkey (170g cooked), then 1 cup veggies, then 1/2 cup pasta sauce poured over.
Top each with 2 tbsp shredded cheese. Seal and refrigerate. Reheat 2 min — add a tiny splash of water before microwaving.

laineLunch.name: Chicken Pasta Salad — Mason Jar Style (Fresh)
laineLunch.note: Only 2 chicken breasts — bake both. Fresh cherry tomatoes, cucumber, and spinach added for Laine. 5 mason jars. Dressing separate. She eats in 2 sittings per jar.
laineLunch.dressingNote: Light Italian or light Caesar — 2 tbsp per jar, kept in a tiny separate lidded container alongside each jar.

ingredients.item: Garofalo pasta (rotini or penne) — 250g dry total (50g per jar)
Garbanzo beans, drained — 1 can total (~85g per jar)
English cucumber — 1 large (sliced or diced, ~1/3 per jar)
Fresh baby spinach — big handful per jar
Light Italian or Caesar dressing — 2 tbsp per jar (kept separate)
Lemon juice, salt, garlic powder (for chicken seasoning)

steps: Season both chicken breasts with garlic powder, salt, pepper. Bake at 400°F for 24 min. Cool completely, then dice small.
Cook all pasta in salted water per package. Drain, rinse cold. Toss with a tiny bit of olive oil.
Halve cherry tomatoes. Dice or slice cucumber. Rinse fresh spinach.
Drain and rinse garbanzo beans.
Layer each mason jar: pasta → garbanzo beans → cucumber → cherry tomatoes → chicken → spinach on top (spinach stays freshest on top, away from the dressing).
Put 2 tbsp dressing in a tiny separate container per jar. Refrigerate.
When eating: pour dressing in, shake, eat half — reseal for the second sitting.

laineBreakfasts.name: Greek Yogurt Parfait
laineBreakfasts.note: Only 2 Oikos left — use Mon + Wed. Thu/Fri rotate to egg whites.
steps: Spoon yogurt into a bowl or jar.
Top with thawed frozen fruit and flaxseed.
Prep the night before if mornings are rushed.

laineBreakfasts.name: Egg White Scramble
steps: Scramble egg whites over medium-low with frozen veggies until just set.
Top with shredded cheese.

laineBreakfasts.name: Birch Benders Pancakes + Fruit

ingredients.item: Birch Benders pancake mix - 1/2 cup dry

steps: Mix pancake mix + egg whites + water per package.
Cook small pancakes 2 min per side on non-stick.
Top with thawed fruit + flaxseed.

jakeSnacks.name: Oikos Triple Zero + Flaxseed
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 Oikos container + 1 tbsp ground flaxseed. Only 2 left — save these for Jake Mon + Tue.

jakeSnacks.name: Egg White Mug + Shredded Cheese
jakeSnacks.desc: 1/2 cup liquid egg whites microwaved in a mug 90 sec. Top with 1 tbsp shredded cheese. Fast, high protein, basically zero carb.

jakeSnacks.name: Tuna Straight from Can
jakeSnacks.desc: Drain and eat with a fork. Add hot sauce or lemon. Zero effort, massive protein.

jakeSnacks.name: Frozen Fruit + Flaxseed
jakeSnacks.desc: 1 cup thawed frozen fruit + 1 tbsp flaxseed. Light, good on higher carb days.
